questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the decision stack framework?
questions.gold_answer: The decision stack provides a six-layer framework that helps engineers read a cloud brief, identify the bottleneck, choose appropriate services, and explain architectural trade-offs.
questions.quote: It shows you how to read a cloud brief, find the real bottleneck and the problem, choose the right AWS services and explain the trade-offs like an actual cloud engineer.
questions.question_hi: decision stack framework ka main purpose kya hota hai?

questions.question: Why does the lecturer advise against using a single EC2 instance for a viral startup?
questions.gold_answer: A single instance cannot scale to handle large traffic spikes, and it is inefficient because it incurs costs even when idle.
questions.quote: Their servers run 24 hours a day, seven days a week and they're paying for it, whether it's handling 10,000 user signups or sitting completely idle with no users at 3 a.m.
questions.question_hi: viral startup ke liye single EC2 instance use karne se mana kyun kiya hai?

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using Lambda for the viral startup scenario?
questions.gold_answer: Lambda scales automatically based on demand and incurs no costs when the application is not being used.
questions.quote: When nobody's using the application, Lambda isn't running and you're paying absolutely nothing. And when a hundred thousand users show up at once, Lambda doesn't struggle or slow down.
questions.question_hi: viral startup scenario mein Lambda use karne ka main advantage kya hai?

questions.question: Why is an auto-scaling group necessary for the e-commerce company?
questions.gold_answer: An auto-scaling group automatically adds or removes EC2 instances based on traffic demand, preventing site crashes during spikes.
questions.quote: The auto-scaling group is what adds more Easter instances when the demand increases. Together, the ALB distributes traffic and the auto-scaling group changes the amount of capacity behind it.
questions.question_hi: e-commerce company ke liye auto-scaling group kyun zaroori hai?

questions.question: What is the purpose of RAG in the AI-powered enterprise scenario?
questions.gold_answer: RAG provides the AI model with company-specific context, such as internal frameworks and policies, allowing it to produce more accurate and useful outputs.
questions.quote: So the AI isn't just looking at a contract with general knowledge, it's looking at that contract plus the company specific framework, plus their routing rules, plus their review deadlines.
questions.question_hi: AI-powered enterprise scenario mein RAG ka kya kaam hai?

questions.question: Why is it important to use Infrastructure as Code instead of the AWS console?
questions.gold_answer: Infrastructure as Code ensures that environments are identical, repeatable, and version-controlled, avoiding the errors associated with manual configuration.
questions.quote: Every environment comes out identical because they've all built from the same source. And because it's a file, you can track every single change, it's version control, right?
questions.question_hi: AWS console ke badle Infrastructure as Code use karna kyun important hai?

questions.question: How does the lecturer define the 'traffic' layer in the decision stack?
questions.gold_answer: The traffic layer covers the entire journey of data from the user opening the application to how different services communicate behind the scenes.
questions.quote: This covers every journey that data takes from a user opening the application and content appearing on a screen to how your services talk to each other behind the scenes.
questions.question_hi: lecturer ne decision stack mein 'traffic' layer ko kaise define kiya hai?

questions.question: What is the significance of the 'least privilege' principle in security?
questions.gold_answer: It ensures that every service only has the specific permissions required for its job, which limits the potential damage if a service is compromised.
questions.quote: Every single permission has to be scoped exactly what the service needs for a specific job, nothing more and nothing less. This is the same least privileged principle that we apply in the first scenario.
questions.question_hi: security mein 'least privilege' principle ka kya significance hai?

questions.gold_answer: A NAT gateway allows resources in a private subnet to make outbound calls to the internet while preventing inbound connections.
